thread:
maria: Heads up — CI evals flagged a regression on canary models. Exact-match (EM_top1) down ~3% after the latest runner change. Blocking today's release.

josh: Which job/metric? link to CI run?

maria: Job: eval/canary/summary-qa, metric: EM_top1. Run id 2025-03-19_09:12. Dashboard shows spike crossing alert threshold. Reporter diff attached to CI artifact: https://ci.example/runs/2025-03-19_09:12/artifacts/diff.txt

sasha: I reproduced locally with the same docker image and seed. Repro only when runner uses `metric-selector=auto` (new default). With `metric-selector=legacy` the EM is back to baseline.

josh: Hmm — PR 4321 touched selector defaults recently. Commit `abc1234` changed fallback ordering. @sasha can you confirm which file?

sasha: Confirmed. Change is in `runner/core/selector.py` in pr/4321 (commit abc1234). Code moved from selecting based on `n-gram-len` heuristics to preferring `auto_priority` which biases toward precision slices. That explains EM drop on summarization.

ana: I'll bisect between v1.12.0 and abc1234 now to be safe. Running a focused eval bisect job.

ana: (typo in previous) Bisect commands I ran:
```
# reproduce auto default
./scripts/eval_runner --model canary --suite summary-qa --metric-selector=auto --seed 42
# reproduce legacy
./scripts/eval_runner --model canary --suite summary-qa --metric-selector=legacy --seed 42
```

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: triggered job `eval-bisect-742` (ana) — https://ci.example/jobs/742

ana: Bisect result: regression introduced in commit abc1234. EM drop reliably reproduces only when `auto` is the default; legacy selector shows no drop. No other commits touching tokenizer/model I/O in the range. Logs attached to job 742.

maria: Given this is a clear quality regression on a primary downstream task, propose rollback of the default selector change for the release. Make `auto` opt-in and add a regression test in eval-CI. @eng-ml - agree?

josh: Agree. I'll open a rollback PR to revert the default config to `legacy` and add a config guard. Will also add a short test in CI to catch >1% EM regressions on summary-qa. PR: https://git.example/r/redwood/runner/pulls/4498

sasha: I'll add the regression test to `eval-ci` (canary gate): fail if EM_top1 delta > 1% relative to goldset for summary-qa. Also adding a note in the selector docstring to prevent silent default flips.

maria: Status update: holding release and pausing canary rollout. Action items: josh -> rollback PR (in flight), sasha -> add CI regression test, ana -> re-run full canary after rollback. I'll update PMs and ops and patch the dashboard alert to point at the bisect job.

josh: Rollback PR opened and CI passing on unit tests; requesting review @eng-ml.

sasha: Test added as a gating check in `eval-ci`. Will monitor next canary.

maria: Thanks team. Release on hold until we confirm canary after rollback. :white_check_mark:
